item.aurelia.grove_shard.lore: Still warm. It smells like cut grass and sugar.
item.aurelia.storm_shard.lore: It hums when the wind changes.
item.aurelia.void_shard.lore: It is lighter than it should be.
item.aurelia.spore_heart.lore: Sporecaps carry these. Plant all four in the Rootbound Citadel.
item.aurelia.soul_sigil.lore: Soul Jailers carry these. The Ashen Citadel wants twelve.
item.aurelia.verdant_shard.lore: Mined in the Gaudy Grove. It is still growing.
item.aurelia.stormglass_shard.lore: Found in the rock of the Skyreach islands. It holds a spark.
item.aurelia.emberheart.lore: Dug from the walls of the Hollow. Warm to the touch.
item.aurelia.tidestone_shard.lore: From the drowned rock of the Expanse. It is always damp.
item.aurelia.rime_crystal.lore: Dug from the Pale Wastes. It never melts and never makes a sound.
item.aurelia.sunglass_shard.lore: Glass the Scarlet Sun made out of the desert. Hot on one side.
item.aurelia.leviathan_pearl.lore: Taken from the deep. Hold it to your ear and you hear a heartbeat.
item.aurelia.frozen_tear.lore: Someone cried, once, where nobody could hear.
item.aurelia.reapers_hourglass.lore: The sand inside has stopped. It is waiting for permission.
item.aurelia.chronite_shard.lore: Crystallised time, chipped from the Rift. It is always slightly warmer than a second ago.
item.aurelia.bloomspore.lore: It pulses in your palm, very slowly, like something asleep.
item.aurelia.hour_core.lore: The heart of the Hour Eater. It ticks backwards.
item.aurelia.bloom_heart.lore: It is still singing, too low to hear.
item.aurelia.relic.hint: One of eight. Lay it on its pedestal at the Convergence Gate.
item.aurelia.hand_of_genesis.use: Use to cast. Sneak and use to change power.
item.aurelia.rootbound_heart.lore: It still beats, slow as a tree grows. Mossback grew around it for a thousand years.
item.aurelia.storm_talon.lore: Lightning crawls along it whenever someone lies nearby.
item.aurelia.sovereign_hand.lore: The King held the crown in this hand when it broke. The soul fire in the palm is hers.
item.aurelia.abyssal_fang.lore: Wet, always. Hold it to your ear and you hear the deep breathing.
item.aurelia.frozen_voice.lore: Everything the White Silence took is in here. If it ever thaws, the Wastes will scream.
item.aurelia.glass_stinger.lore: The last grain of the Sovereign's hourglass, kept where no one could turn it.
item.aurelia.chronal_eye.lore: It watches the moment just behind this one.
item.aurelia.living_spore.lore: Plant it and it would grow a world. That is the problem.
item.aurelia.hand_of_genesis.lore: The hand that cut the worlds apart. Now it is yours.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.verdant: Full set: Regeneration II; poison cannot touch you; anyone who strikes you takes 4 damage and is rooted. Green spores drift round you.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.stormglass: Full set: Jump Boost III, Speed I, no fall damage; a third of those who strike you are struck by lightning. Sparks crackle round you.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.emberheart: Full set: Fire Resistance and Strength I; anyone who strikes you burns for 6 seconds. Embers rise off you.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.tidestone: Full set: Water Breathing; Dolphin's Grace, Conduit Power and Regeneration in water or rain. Bubbles stream off you.
item.aurelia.glowing_gel.power: Water Breathing and Night Vision for 30 seconds.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.rime: Full set: Immune to freezing, walk on powder snow, Resistance I; water freezes under your feet; anyone who strikes you is frozen. Snow falls round you.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.sunglass: Full set: By day Haste II and Strength II, by night Night Vision; a third of arrows and projectiles glance off you. Sunlight glints round you.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.chronite: Full set: Speed II and Haste II. Borrowed Time: a killing blow throws you back to where you stood five seconds ago at half health instead (once every 90 s).
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.bloomspore: Full set: Night Vision; poison and wither cannot touch you; it feeds you when hungry; allies near you regenerate; anyone who strikes you is poisoned.
item.aurelia.rootbreaker.power: Roots the target (Slowness III), poisons it, and heals you a heart.
item.aurelia.rootbreaker.ability: Bramble Eruption: thorns tear up through the ground in a line ahead (10 damage, rooted). 8 s.
item.aurelia.stormpiercer.power: Throws the target into the air with a crack of thunder.
item.aurelia.stormpiercer.ability: Tempest Dash: you are flung eight blocks forward and lightning strikes everything you pass (12 damage). 6 s.
item.aurelia.soulcleaver.power: Sets the target on fire and withers it.
item.aurelia.soulcleaver.ability: Soul Inferno: a ring of soul fire bursts out round you (14 damage, burning, thrown back). 10 s.
item.aurelia.tidebinder.power: Drags the target toward you; half again as hard in water.
item.aurelia.tidebinder.ability: Maelstrom: every enemy within 12 blocks is dragged to you and half-drowned (8 damage, slowed). 10 s.
item.aurelia.silent_requiem.power: Freezes the target; strikes twice as hard from a crouch.
item.aurelia.silent_requiem.ability: Whiteout Step: you vanish and reappear behind whatever you are looking at, striking it (18 damage, frozen). 6 s.
item.aurelia.venomfangs.power: Very fast. Poisons the target, and half the blow cuts everything else within reach.
item.aurelia.venomfangs.ability: Fang Flurry: you whirl through everything within 6 blocks (16 damage, Poison II). 8 s.
item.aurelia.hourshatter.power: Its bladed limbs slow and weaken whatever they cut.
item.aurelia.hourshatter.ability: Hour Volley: fires five chronite bolts in a fan; whatever they hit is frozen in time for 4 seconds. 3 s.
item.aurelia.sporethorn.power: Poisons and sickens the target and everything near it.
item.aurelia.sporethorn.ability: Bloom Burst: a cloud of spores bursts out (Poison III, nausea) and you heal for every enemy it catches. 10 s.
item.aurelia.caged_soul_ember.lore: A soul that would not stop burning, kept.
item.aurelia.frozen_black_flame_core.lor: Black fire, frozen mid-flicker. It is very cold to hold and it is still burning.
item.aurelia.amber_venom_vial.lore: The sands' oldest poison, set like amber.
item.aurelia.temporal_core.lore: It ticks a little faster than the world does.
item.aurelia.genesis_ingot.lore: Metal that remembers being every metal at once.
item.aurelia.fractured_genesis.lore: What was left in the Unmaker when the worlds were taken back. Three fall with it every time it dies.
item.aurelia.worldsunder.power: Unmaking: every hit also deals 3% of the target's max health (up to 15 more), and carries the next of the eight realm powers in turn: root, storm, fire, tide, frost, sweep, time, spores.
item.aurelia.worldsunder.ability: Singularity: a black hole opens six blocks ahead, drags in everything within twelve blocks, then collapses (30 damage, Wither II, slowed). 20 s.
item.aurelia.worldsunder.lore: Eight weapons, melted into one by the thing that broke them.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.genesis.0: Strength II, Resistance I, Fire Resistance, Night Vision, Water Breathing; poison, wither, freezing and falling cannot touch you.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.genesis.1: Event Horizon: no single blow can take more than 30% of your health, and half of all arrows and projectiles are swallowed.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.genesis.2: Eightfold Retaliation: whatever strikes you takes 6 damage and one realm's curse: rooted, struck, burned, dragged, frozen, cut, slowed or poisoned.
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.genesis.3: The Last Heart: a killing blow leaves you at half health instead, with Absorption IV and a shockwave that throws back and hurts everything near you (once every 2 minutes).
item.aurelia.armor_bonus.genesis.4: Crouch in mid-air to drift down slowly.
item.aurelia.rime_knight_spawn_egg: The Knight of Last Winter Spawn Egg
item.aurelia.herald_of_ruin_spawn_egg: The Herald of Ruin Spawn Egg
item.aurelia.herald_of_silence_spawn_egg: The Herald of Silence Spawn Egg
